review_description: We had a few hiccups along the way but nothing was really a problem. The installers were really nice crew and they were in and out before we knew it. Its a pretty exciting concept. I think I may be addicted to the technology that goes with it!

We received 6 quotes. Eko - Connect and one you submitted Sun Edison offered the best advise and were the best price. The systems were very similar in quality but EKO- connect got the nod on price and future upgrades flexibility.
